sections.h2: PLI-LSEM beat its five-year investment and production targets

chart.title: PLI-LSEM passed every headline target, led by investment at 294%
chart.sub: Cumulative actual as a share of five-year target, %, to March 2026.

sections.means: The government reports PLI-LSEM beating each of its three five-year targets.
sections.todo: Check the domestic value addition figure of 23% against the target before counting this scheme a full success.

sections.h2: ECMS approvals already pass its investment target, with jobs at 81%

chart.title: ECMS approvals reach 117% of the investment target but 81% of jobs
chart.sub: Approved amount as a share of the original scheme target, %, as of 17 August 2026.

sections.means: Approvals so far already exceed the scheme's original investment envelope, while job approvals lag behind it.
sections.todo: Track the 38 plants already producing and the 16 under advanced construction as the next measure of ECMS progress.

sections.h2: Only five of twelve Semicon projects are producing so far

chart.title: Five of 12 approved Semicon projects have started commercial production
chart.sub: Approved manufacturing projects under the Semicon India Programme, count.
chart.source: Government announcement at SEMICON India 2026, 17-19 September; original post.

sections.means: Five of the twelve approved projects are running, and all five are assembly, test or packaging lines rather than wafer fabs.
sections.todo: Watch whether the remaining seven projects reach commercial production before India's first fab is due in 2028.
